title: BPW-2026-0562
text:
[BUREAU OF SANITATION]
BPW-2026-0562
CD 11, 15
REQUEST FOR AUTHORITY – HARBOR TOXIC POLLUTANTS TOTAL MAXIMUM DAILY LOADS
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE and FORWARD this report, with its transmittals, to the mayor with the request to authorize the President or two members of the Board of Public Works to execute the 2026 Agreement for the cost sharing of the installation of monitoring equipment and monitoring pursuant the Harbor Toxic Pollutants Total Maximum Daily Loads; and
​​​​​​UPON the Mayor’s authorization, the President or two Commissioners of the Board will execute the Agreement.
